title: Waltz in C
short: Ferdinando Carulli (1770–1841) · C 3/8 · play it with every note lit.

blocks.html: A little waltz in the old one-two-three: a bass note on the first beat, then two soft pairs of notes. The thumb (p) plays the bass on the 4th, 5th or 6th string; the index and middle fingers (i and m) pluck the two higher notes at the same moment. The middle part moves to A minor; then the first two parts come back once more. Keep the bass a little louder than the chords.

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys or strings light up as each note sounds.

blocks.html: The piece: Waltz, Op. 241 No. 1, from Carulli’s easy pieces for guitar, as printed in A. Eggers’s Guitar-Skole
